entities.name: Hypatia of Alexandria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandrian mathematician, astronomer, and Neoplatonic philosopher (c. 360–415 CE), the last great scholar of the Library of Alexandria era. She taught prominent students from across the Mediterranean, edited Ptolemy's Almagest and Diophantus' Arithmetica, and was murdered by a Christian mob — becoming a symbol of intellectual freedom against religious fanaticism.
